gloss: To extend one's own feelings to others; to empathize.
teaser: Ever wondered how understanding others can change your interactions?
script: Welcome to Chengyu Bites — your quick summary on Chinese 成语. Ever wondered how understanding others can change your interactions?[break 1s] The phrase is: 推己及人, tuī jǐ jí rén.[break 0.5s] 推 (tuī) - to push;[break 0.5s] 己 (jǐ) - oneself;[break 0.5s] 及 (jí) - to reach;[break 0.5s] 人 (rén) - people.[break 1s] The full idiom again: 推己及人, which literally means 'to push oneself to others' and figuratively signifies the act of empathizing with others.[break 1s] Here’s the story behind it:[break 1.5s] This idiom originates from the idea that one should treat others the way they wish to be treated themselves. It emphasizes the importance of empathy and understanding in human interactions. The concept is deeply rooted in Confucianism, which encourages individuals to consider the feelings and perspectives of others. Thus, 推己及人 serves as a moral reminder.[break 1.5s] Example 1: 他总是推己及人，关心朋友的感受。  He always empathizes and cares about his friends' feelings.[break 1s] Example 2: 在工作中，推己及人能促进团队的合作。  Empathizing with others at work can enhance teamwork.[break 1s] Example 3: 教育孩子推己及人是很重要的。  It is important to teach children to empathize with others.[break 1s] So, that's 推己及人, meaning to extend one's own feelings to others. Thank you for listening to Chengyu Bites! See you next time for another idiom.[break 1s]
